decisions.reason: The selected image is a conditional target for character details and features; it does not change the restyle task, covered characters, or established raw-graffiti style traits.
Selecting a detail-and-feature reference does not alter the requirement to restore character shadows using the earlier renders as the shadow reference.
Message 90 selects an image because of its details and features, not as a replacement for the visual-style reference or the raw-graffiti style traits established in messages 87 and 89.
A character detail reference does not change SQ12 shot angles, frame specifications, specification methods, or its deferred lifecycle.
The detail target does not alter the character-pair count, character membership, image count, or wide-to-close framing progression.
The character detail reference has no effect on animation remaining the primary presentation medium.
The source decision concerns character-detail imagery and does not change revised-script authority, storyboard precedence, or the method for specifying shots.
A preferred character detail reference does not change the quality rules or generation options for set images.
The selected character detail reference does not alter which background bridges must be removed or retained in Kestrel images.
The source decision does not change SQ11 shot-angle authority, storyboard status, shot-specification method, or deferred lifecycle.
The character detail target is unrelated to SQ4 shot angles, frame counts, storyboard differences, or the unresolved shot-specification ambiguity.
The preferred character detail reference does not change the SQ4 energy-blast requirement or its deferred lifecycle.
